routes.name: Tourist eVisa
routes.summary: Single-entry electronic visa for tourism and other non-business trips. Citizens of all countries can apply online. You get 30 or 90 days. Apply at least 3 days before you arrive.

other: Passport valid at least 6 months from your planned entry date
Scanned color passport copy and a recent passport-size photo
The portal doesn't accept credit cards from applicants in Cuba, Iraq, Sudan, Yemen, Somalia, North Korea, Afghanistan, South Sudan, Crimea and Syria
Beware of copycat sites. Use evisa.gov.et only

stay.note: Validity starts from your planned arrival date. Extensions of 1 to 15 days are online. Longer extensions are in person at the ICS head office in Addis Ababa.

routes.name: Tourist Visa on Arrival and Visa Exemptions
routes.summary: Ethiopia lists many nationalities (dozens of countries across Africa, Europe, the Americas and Asia) that can get a tourist visa on arrival. Citizens of Kenya and Djibouti with a valid passport can enter without a visa.

other: The official page has a paginated country list. We couldn't confirm the full list, so check your country on the page.
On-arrival fee and stay length are not stated on the page we read

sources.label: Ethiopia eVisa: tourist visa on arrival list

routes.name: Investment Visa (IV)
routes.summary: For foreigners engaged in investment, or potential investors who want to come and invest. Needs support letters from an Ethiopian embassy and the Ethiopian Investment Commission. Valid 30 days up to 12 months.

other: Passport valid at least 6 months from entry, with copy and recent photo
Support letter from the nearest Ethiopian embassy showing the investment purpose
Official application letter from the inviting organization to ICS
Business license of the inviting company
Support letter from the Ethiopian Investment Commission

stay.note: Options: 30 days single entry, 90 days, 6 months or 12 months multiple entry.

routes.name: Foreign Business Firm Employment Visa (WV)
routes.summary: For foreigners hired by a business owned or run by foreigners in Ethiopia. Needs a work permit confirmation from the Ministry of Labor and Social Affairs. Valid 30 or 90 days.

other: Passport valid at least 6 months from entry, with copy and recent photo
Support letter from the inviting organization, issued within the last week
Letter from the Minister of Labor and Social Affairs saying a work permit was granted
Business license and TIN certificate of the inviting company
Renewals need a copy of the last extended WV visa

sources.label: Ethiopia eVisa: foreign business firm employment visa

routes.name: Student Visa (SV)
routes.summary: For foreigners entering Ethiopia to study full-time at a recognized institution. The eVisa portal lists a single-entry 30-day visa that can't be extended. The ICS page says the visa covers the length of studies, so confirm which applies.

other: Passport valid at least 6 months from entry
Acceptance letter from an accredited Ethiopian institution
Proof of tuition paid or scholarship details, and proof of enough money to live on (ICS page)
The two official pages describe validity differently, so check with ICS before applying

stay.note: Per the eVisa portal. ICS describes the visa as covering the duration of studies.

routes.name: Residence Visa (IMV)
routes.summary: For foreigners who stay in Ethiopia for a set time and later get permanent residency. Used by holders of a foreign investor employee visa or a residence ID, and their family. Valid 30 days single entry or 90 days multiple entry.

other: Passport valid at least 6 months from entry, with recent photo
Copy of the IMV foreign investor employee visa (latest extension) or residence ID
Authenticated birth certificate for minors and marriage certificate for spouses

stay.note: Extend in person at the ICS head office in Addis Ababa.

routes.name: Permanent Residence ID (five-year, renewable)
routes.summary: A residence ID valid 5 years and renewable. It's employer-linked: your company writes to ICS. You need a valid work or tourist visa.

other: Letter to ICS from an employer with a valid trade certificate
Company trade certificate
Passport copy, valid work or tourist visa, and visa stamp
Fee not listed on the page

routes.name: Temporary Residence Permit Through Marriage
routes.summary: For foreigners married to an Ethiopian citizen. Renewable. You need proof of marriage, your spouse's ID or passport, and proof of money (500,000 birr in the bank, or a house title or vehicle license).

other: Married to an Ethiopian citizen. Marriage certificate from abroad must be authenticated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and translated if not in English or Amharic
Bank statement of 500,000 birr or more with a bank letter, or a house title, or a vehicle license
Application letter from the Ethiopian spouse
Passport valid 6 months, entry visa copy, two photos, completed form
Fee amount not listed on the page

routes.processing: ICS says most applications take about 5 to 10 business days, some longer.

sources.label: ICS: Temporary Residence Permit Through Marriage

routes.name: Ethiopian Origin ID
routes.summary: For people of Ethiopian descent who hold foreign citizenship. It gives visa-free entry, the right to own property and easier access to residency and work. ICS also lists versions by marriage and for children under 18.

other: Ethiopian descent and foreign citizenship
Ordinary passport valid more than 6 months, entry visa copy, one photo
Machine-readable Ethiopian passport or authenticated birth certificate, plus a parent's Kebele ID or passport
Can't be issued by proxy. Daily penalty if you renew late
